entities.name: Zoran Savić
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Zoran Savić is a Serbian professional basketball executive and former professional player who last worked as the sports director for Partizan Belgrade of the Serbian KLS, the Adriatic League and the EuroLeague. The 2.06 m tall center played in various European countries throughout his career.
